contract.phase_scope: All original 12 phases at all five seeds; historical cutoffs stay separate. February alone retains daily detail; no phase pooling.
contract.ranking: Full closed day, score DESC then order_id ASC, floor(N/10); unknown outcomes compete before known/group masks.
contract.common_miss: Known delayed and unalerted by all four versions within one seed.
contract.persistent_miss: Known delayed and unalerted by all four versions at all five seeds (20 model evaluations of the same identity).
contract.other_misses: Each version keeps its five-seed common/union/multiplicity. Newly lost always means that contrast own old alert and own new non-alert.
contract.groups: ALL, all observed routes plus fixed SP->RJ/SP->SC/SP->SP, original RPA marginals/eight cells, original five age bins inside110. R=SP->RJ; P=21<promise<=30; A=24<age_p90<=72 hours.
contract.boundary: One-based full-day rank minus daily capacity. Fixed bins inside_budget, one_to_three, four_to_ten, eleven_plus; capacity-zero rows separate. No raw-score comparison across models.
contract.tie: Cutoff ties and ties spanning the selected/unselected boundary are descriptive. ID breaks all ties; no new threshold.
contract.exchanges: Within day/group min(added,dropped), outgoing=max(dropped-added,0), incoming=max(added-dropped,0); sum daily gross. Route and RPA-cell partitions reconcile independently.
contract.statistics: All five seeds retained. Counts/rank-bin counts report mean/min/max, never confidence intervals. Known-delay denominator fixed within each phase/group. Zero denominators yield null.
contract.privacy: Public aggregates only; no order IDs, ID hashes, individual ranks or individual scores.
prohibitions: No model loading, replay, fit, seed/model selection, new features, quotas, thresholds or default-model replacement.
No original retained-holdout scoring; inspected historical/development data are not new unknown tests.
No causal sampling claim or individual donor/recipient pairing. Dashboard remains deferred.

schema.gap_definition: One-based complete-day rank minus floor(full-day rows / 10); capacity_zero is separate regardless of distance.
schema.privacy: Only the separate private return value contains order identities or row-aligned ranks.

limitations: The same inspected historical validation and development orders are reused; five seeds and20 model evaluations are not independent data.
Rank-gap bins describe distance under the existing daily budget. They do not estimate the performance of a changed budget or policy.
Daily co-occurrence of route/cell outflow and inflow is not identified order-level displacement or feature causality.
All12 phase contexts remain separate, including repeated months with different historical outcome cutoffs.
No new training intervention was selected or executed. Original default RF and research primary remain unchanged.
